tasks.subject: Churned Tenant Domain Redirect & Location-Aware Marketplace Discovery
tasks.description:
Implement dynamic routing logic for simple hosted business websites belonging to churned/canceled Aspio tenants. When any visitor accesses a web domain or sub-domain of a business that has left or canceled its Aspio subscription, automatically redirect the request to the Marketplace Discover page. 

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Tenant Status Check: Middleware/DNS router verifies tenant subscription status upon incoming web requests to tenant simple website URLs.

✅ Automatic Redirect: If the tenant status is churned, canceled, or inactive, intercept the request and perform a 302/301 redirect to the Marketplace /discover route.

✅ Location-Aware Parameter Hand-off: Extract the last known city, address, or geographic coordinates of the churned business and pass them as URL parameters (e.g., /discover?location=Addis+Ababa or /discover?lat=...\&lng=...).

✅ Marketplace Pre-filtering: Ensure the Marketplace Discover page automatically parses the location query parameters and defaults the search radius and active vendor listings to that specific city/area.

✅ Graceful Fallback: If the churned business has no recorded address, fall back to standard IP geolocation or the default global/city Discover view.

When searching for a company, the dropdown overlaps and hides the search field.

Acceptance Criteria
✅ Dropdown appears below the search field
✅ Search input stays visible while typing
✅ Dropdown is scrollable if there are many results
✅ Dropdown is not cut off by the keyboard or screen edge

tasks.subject: Add page titles to the mobile header
tasks.description:
Pages like Loyalty, Deals and Journal have no title in the mobile header, unlike the web version.

Acceptance Criteria
✅ Loyalty, Deals, Journal and similar pages show a page title in the header
✅ Titles match the web version
✅ Titles are Swedish and fit on small screens without being cut off

tasks.subject: Make Journal tabs consistent between web and mobile
tasks.description:
Journal has 3 tabs on web but 4 on mobile.

Acceptance Criteria
✅ Confirm with design whether the extra mobile tab is intentional
✅ Web and mobile show the same tabs (or the difference is documented as intentional)
✅ Tab names and order are the same on both platforms

tasks.subject: Make loyalty ads horizontally scrollable on My Bookings
tasks.description:
Loyalty ads on My Bookings are fixed and take up screen space that should go to the booking cards.

Acceptance Criteria
✅ Loyalty ads scroll horizontally
✅ Ads take up less space and no longer stay fixed on the screen
✅ Booking cards are the main focus of the page
✅ Scrolling is smooth and works on all phone sizes

tasks.subject: Center the Location pop-up on mobile
tasks.description:
The pop-up opened from the Location button is aligned toward the top of the screen.

Acceptance Criteria
✅ Pop-up is centered on the screen with balanced spacing around it
✅ Pop-up can be closed easily (close button or tap outside)
✅ Looks good on small and large phone screens

tasks.subject: Add search to Recommended and Nearby Businesses pages
tasks.description:
The dedicated Recommended Businesses and Nearby Businesses pages have no search, so users must scroll through the full list.

Acceptance Criteria
✅ Search field is at the top of both pages
✅ Typing filters the businesses shown in that section
✅ "No results" message is shown when nothing matches
✅ Clearing the search shows the full list again

tasks.subject: Add is_company_offboarded control on admin UI
tasks.description:
Implement UI controls and status displays for the is\_company\_offboarded flag on the admin dashboard and company management views.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Add a toggle or status indicator for is\_company\_offboarded (true/false) in the admin panel.

✅ Ensure administrators can update a company's offboarded status with proper confirmation dialogs.

✅ Verify that offboarded companies correctly restrict or reflect appropriate access states across the system.

tasks.subject: Fix splash screen showing in the marketplace on app open
tasks.description:
When the app opens, the Aspio splash screen (logo and text) is shown on the left side of the marketplace instead of disappearing, and the marketplace layout is pushed to the side and cut off (screenshot 1).

Acceptance Criteria
✅ Splash screen is shown full screen on app open and then disappears
✅ Splash screen and marketplace are never visible at the same time
✅ Marketplace loads at full width with no cut-off content
✅ Works on small and large phone screens
✅ Works on first open and when reopening the app

tasks.subject: Fix raw HTML tags showing in service descriptions
tasks.description:
Service descriptions in the booking flow show raw HTML tags like  and  instead of line breaks (screenshots 2 and 3).

Affected companies:

Rosa Daisy Beauty: shows   (Keratin behandling+ klippning, Brazilien Keratin långt hår)
Monika's Hårstudio på Diez / Globen: shows  (Scalp Detox, Behandling för fett hår med klippning och styling)

Acceptance Criteria
✅  and  are shown as real line breaks, not as text
✅ Descriptions with bullet lines (e.g. Scalp Detox) show each point on its own line
✅ Collapsed description preview does not show any HTML tags
✅ "Visa mindre" / "Visa mer" still works
✅ HTML is sanitized so only safe formatting (line breaks) is allowed
✅ Fixed for Rosa Daisy Beauty and Monika's Hårstudio på Diez / Globen
✅ Fix applies to all other salons and service descriptions

tasks.subject: Support multiple service categories for marketplace services
tasks.description:
Enable the marketplace and booking flow to support multiple service categories for services created or configured with multiple categories in the business app.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Update the database model and API endpoints to allow services to belong to multiple categories.

✅ Ensure multi-category support functions seamlessly when creating or editing services in the business app.

✅ Verify that services display correctly across all assigned categories on the marketplace and booking flows.

tasks.subject: Prepare the marketplace and business for staging (conflict resolved and merged)
tasks.description:
Resolve ongoing merge conflicts and safely merge code branches across the Marketplace and Business App repositories, ensuring all staging environments are properly deployed and verified post-push.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Inspect, rebase, and resolve all code merge conflicts between feature branches and staging branches.

✅ Run build, lint, and unit test suites locally to ensure zero post-merge regressions.

✅ Push updated branches to staging environment and verify successful deployment across both Marketplace and Business App services.

tasks.subject: Add Swedish language support to Aspio Staff Management app
tasks.description:
Integrate Swedish language support into the Aspio Staff Management application, including localized string files, language selection option, and UI translation updates.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Add comprehensive Swedish (sv) translation files across all staff app modules.

✅ Add Swedish as an selectable option in the app language selector.

✅ Verify that all dynamic UI strings, labels, and error messages render accurately in Swedish without layout clipping.

tasks.subject: Refine Amharic and English translations in Aspio Staff Management app
tasks.description:
Review and refine existing Amharic and English translation strings across the Aspio Staff Management app for grammatical accuracy, consistency, and proper context.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Audit and fix terminology discrepancies in English and Amharic strings across all screens.

✅ Ensure correct character rendering, right-to-left/alignment formatting, and typography for Amharic.

✅ Verify that all localized text fits within UI components gracefully without truncation.

tasks.subject: Implement screen-specific shimmer loading states in Aspio Staff Management app
tasks.description:
Replace generic loading shimmer placeholders with customized screen-specific shimmer components that mirror the exact layout structure of the upcoming page content in the Aspio Staff Management app.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Identify all views currently using general/generic shimmer loading screens.

✅ Design and implement layout-matched shimmer templates for each target page (e.g., dashboard, staff list, shift views).

✅ Ensure seamless visual transitions when real data replaces the shimmer loading states.

tasks.subject: Design UI/UX for Quick Action Modals (Create Booking & Customer, Log payment)
tasks.description:
Design UI/UX mockups and wireframes for Quick Action Modals accessible directly from the main dashboard, specifically covering 'Create Booking' and 'Create Customer' modal workflows.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Design intuitive, streamlined modal overlay UI/UX for 'Create Booking' and 'Create Customer' quick actions.

✅ Include clear form layouts, input fields, validation states, and explicit primary/secondary action buttons.

✅ Ensure modals are responsive and optimized for both desktop and tablet dashboard views.

tasks.subject: Implement extracting parked receipts in POS
tasks.description:
Implement functionality in the POS system to retrieve, view, and unpark previously parked/held receipt transactions so cashiers can complete the checkout process.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Create a UI modal/drawer in POS to view a list of all currently parked receipts with search/filter capabilities.

✅ Allow cashiers to select and extract a parked receipt, populating the current register/cart session with its item lines and customer data.

✅ Ensure extracted receipts are removed or marked as resumed in the parked list and handle concurrent session locks smoothly.

tasks.subject: Design UI/UX for Daily Revenue Tracking dashboard widget
tasks.description:
Design UI/UX components for the Daily Revenue Tracking widget on the main dashboard, highlighting total accrued daily revenue, dynamic real-time updates, and zero-reset indicators.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Design visual card/widget layouts displaying real-time daily revenue totals clearly at a glance.

✅ Include visual states for live payment increments and midnight automatic zero-reset indicators.

✅ Maintain design consistency with established dashboard color hierarchy and typography standards.

tasks.subject: Design UI/UX for Staff Attendance Monitoring view
tasks.description:
Design UI/UX components for receptionist staff attendance monitoring, providing a quick, highly scannable status view of checked-in, checked-out, and on-break team members.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Create a dedicated, highly scannable attendance monitoring component tailored for receptionist workflows.

✅ Incorporate clear visual indicators/badges for staff status (e.g., Checked In, Checked Out, On Break).

✅ Ensure seamless visual integration within the existing receptionist dashboard interface.

tasks.subject: Design UI/UX for Petty Cash Tracking module
tasks.description:
Design UI/UX interfaces for logging, tracking, and viewing petty cash transactions directly within the business application system.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Design input forms and flow for logging new petty cash expenses and income adjustments.

✅ Design a detailed ledger table/view showing historical petty cash transactions, categories, and balance updates.

✅ Ensure accessibility and clear button hierarchy for rapid data entry during daily operations.

tasks.subject: Design UI/UX for KPI & Performance Tracking dashboard
tasks.description:
Design UI/UX components for staff KPI & performance tracking, including top performers, at-risk flags, revenue per service breakdowns, and timeframe filters (Daily, Weekly, 3-Month).

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Design visual metrics cards and dashboard widgets for key performance indicators (KPIs).

✅ Include distinct visual badges/flags for Top Performers and At-Risk Staff (declining metrics, attendance issues, poor reviews).

✅ Implement timeframe controls (Daily, Weekly, 3-Month/Quarterly) and revenue segmentation per staff member by service rendered.

tasks.subject: Design UI/UX for Staff History & Review Mapping
tasks.description:
Design UI/UX for staff history and review mapping, showing complete booking history per staff member and linking customer reviews directly to staff profiles and appointments.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Design a searchable, filterable booking history ledger view for individual staff profiles.

✅ Create a review mapping interface that links customer star ratings and feedback directly to specific staff members and booking IDs.

✅ Maintain design visual hierarchy and layout consistency across profile views.

tasks.subject: Design UI/UX for Customer-Staff Relationship Mapping
tasks.description:
Design UI/UX features for customer-staff relationship tracking, showcasing repeat client retention rates, preferred staff booking trends, and customer affinity metrics.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Create visual retention indicators and preferred staff metrics cards on both customer and staff profiles.

✅ Design trend charts/views showing repeat booking frequency and customer loyalty metrics per staff member.

✅ Ensure clear data visualization for quick scanning by managers and receptionists.

tasks.subject: Design UI/UX for Security & Access Control Configurations
tasks.description:
Design UI/UX configurations for role-based security & access control to protect sensitive staff data, performance metrics, and dashboard views.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Design permission configuration screens allowing admins to assign role-based access levels (e.g., Owner, Manager, Receptionist, Staff).

✅ Define visual restricted states and access-denied/locked view states for protected dashboard sections.

✅ Ensure intuitive management of security roles and data privacy controls across the application.

tasks.subject: Implement discount no code  in Business App
tasks.description:
Implement a link generator in the Business App allowing business owners to create custom discount links with configured parameters (discount percentage/amount, expiration date, usage limits).

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Add UI components and API logic in the Business App to generate unique referral/discount links.

✅ Ensure owners can specify discount values (e.g., percentage off or flat amount) and optional link restrictions.

✅ Support copying and sharing generated links directly from the management interface.

tasks.subject: Apply discounts with outcode in booking flow
tasks.description:
Integrate dynamic discount application logic in the booking flow when a user accesses the site via an owner-generated discount link.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Parse discount token/parameters from link URLs when visitors open the booking page.

✅ Automatically calculate and apply the discount amount/percentage to cart subtotals during checkout.

✅ Display clear visual confirmation of the applied discount and validate link expiry or usage limits before final booking submission.

tasks.subject: Design UI/UX for link-based discount campaign builder page
tasks.description:
Design UI/UX mockups and wireframes for a campaign creation page in the Business App, enabling owners to build campaigns for exclusive link-based service discounts.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Design campaign setup workflow screens (campaign name, target service selection, discount percentage/flat amount, and expiration terms).

✅ Include campaign summary and shareable link generation preview interfaces with quick copy/share options.

✅ Create a campaign performance overview section (tracking total link clicks, bookings generated, and revenue from discount links).

tasks.subject: Support team-level configuration and customization in Aspio HR app
tasks.description:
Implement team-level configuration and customization settings within the Aspio HR app to support department/team-specific preferences, rules, and administrative controls.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Create backend endpoints and database models for storing team-specific configuration settings.

✅ Develop team settings UI views allowing team leads/admins to manage department preferences and operational rules.

✅ Ensure settings dynamically apply across team members in the Aspio HR app.

tasks.subject: Implement theme and color controls for HRMS staff app (Mobile & Web)
tasks.description:
Provide configurable color palette and theme controls for the HRMS staff application across both Mobile and Web platforms.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Implement theme/color palette configuration options in the admin controls for the HRMS staff app.

✅ Ensure cross-platform support for custom branding/theme application across Mobile (iOS/Android) and Web.

✅ Verify that color changes dynamically update across UI elements maintaining accessibility and visual contrast standards.

tasks.subject: Integrate Telegram Bot for automated messaging & system alerts
tasks.description:
Develop and integrate a dedicated Telegram bot to send automated system alerts, notifications, and status updates directly to team members.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Set up Telegram bot webhook integration and user ID mapping in the Aspio platform.

✅ Support automated messaging triggers for system alerts and critical operational notifications.

✅ Ensure users can connect and manage their Telegram notification preferences safely

tasks.subject: Implement In-App Messaging broadcast page for HR admins
tasks.description:
Build an In-App Messaging page for HR admins to broadcast direct messages and announcements to team members within the application.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Create an HR admin interface to compose, schedule, and broadcast messages to specific teams, specific staff or all staff.

✅ Ensure broadcasted messages are delivered seamlessly to staff mobile and web inboxes in real time.

✅ Add message delivery tracking and read status confirmation indicators for HR admins.

tasks.subject: Build Company News Feed for company-wide announcements
tasks.description:
Create a dedicated Company News Feed module for publishing company-wide announcements, updates, and organizational news.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Develop UI components for an engaging, scannable company news feed across web and mobile views.

✅ Enable HR admins and managers to draft, publish, pin, and archive news posts.

✅ Include engagement features such as read confirmations, reactions, or comments if configured

tasks.subject: Implement interactive Org Chart with Click-to-Talk contact capability
tasks.description:
Develop an interactive visual organization chart with integrated click-to-talk capability to initiate direct conversations with team members.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Build a visual, interactive organization chart displaying reporting hierarchies and team structures.

✅ Include a quick action click-to-talk/click-to-message control on each staff profile node in the chart.

✅ Ensure selecting click-to-talk immediately opens an in-app messaging or direct contact channel with the selected team member.

tasks.subject: Implement automated Shift Reminders with admin timing controls
tasks.description:
Develop automated shift reminder logic to send timely shift alerts to staff members, accompanied by admin/owner configuration controls to manage reminder intervals and delivery preferences.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Create scheduled background triggers for dispatching shift notification alerts to staff members.

✅ Build admin and owner management controls to customize notification lead times (e.g., 24h, 2h before shift) and preferred notification channels.

✅ Ensure notification logs accurately record sent reminders and delivery statuses.

tasks.subject: Implement Automated Reporting via Email and Telegram
tasks.description:
Implement automated, scheduled system reporting to generate and deliver key operational and business reports directly via Email and Telegram.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Set up background cron/scheduling workers to generate daily/weekly/monthly PDF/summary reports.

✅ Build integration pipelines to format and deliver scheduled reports seamlessly via Email (SMTP/Transactional API) and Telegram Bot channels.

✅ Create administrative settings to configure reporting frequency, target metrics, and recipient lists.

tasks.subject: Implement Payroll Logging for staff payroll operations
tasks.description:
Implement payroll logging functionality to record, track, and manage all staff payroll operations and salary distributions across the platform.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Create database models and endpoints for logging salary distributions, bonuses, deductions, and payment histories.

✅ Build admin UI to view, filter, and audit detailed payroll records for all staff members.

✅ Ensure data validation and audit logging for all created or modified payroll records.

tasks.subject: Implement Payroll Reporting and export capabilities
tasks.description:
Develop payroll reporting tools to generate clear, structured payroll reports scoped specifically for this phase's reporting requirements.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Build reporting interfaces allowing admins to generate period-based payroll summaries (monthly, quarterly, annual).

✅ Include breakdown metrics by staff member, department, net pay, taxes, and total payroll expenditure.

✅ Support exporting generated payroll reports in CSV and PDF formats.

tasks.subject: Implement Unified Calendar View for shifts, events, and schedules
tasks.description:
Develop a centralized unified calendar view aggregating staff shifts, team events, leaves, and operational schedules across mobile and web interfaces.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Create a unified calendar dashboard with daily, weekly, and monthly views.

✅ Aggregate staff shift rosters, company events, leave requests, and key operational deadlines in a single interface.

✅ Support filter controls by team, department, shift type, or individual staff member.

tasks.subject: Implement Single Account Auth across the Aspio HR
tasks.description:
Implement single account authentication and SSO plugin integration across the entire Aspio suite (POS, Business App, and HRMS).

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Unify user authentication so staff and admins can seamlessly log in once across all Aspio modules.

✅ Support role-based access tokens and unified credential management across web and mobile platforms.

✅ Integrate auth plugin hooks for third-party identity providers and existing tenant databases.

tasks.subject: Integrate Document File Storage (Google Drive) in HRMS app
tasks.description:
Integrate document file storage using Google Drive API to enable in-app document management, upload, viewing, and organization within the HRMS app.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Set up Google Drive API integration and authentication service accounts.

✅ Build in-app document storage interface supporting folder structures, file uploads, previews, and access permissions.

✅ Ensure secure handling of employee records, contracts, and HR documentation with appropriate access controls.

tasks.subject: Implement HR Document Access Control & Security Permissions
tasks.description:
Establish file permission and document sharing controls within the HR document storage system to protect sensitive personnel files.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Implement fine-grained permission rules (View, Edit, Admin) for document folders and individual files.

✅ Restrict access to sensitive personnel files (e.g., contracts, pay slips, performance reviews) based on user roles (Owner, Manager, Staff).

✅ Add activity logging for file access, downloads, and modifications.

tasks.subject: Build Academy and Training Module for Aspio HR App
tasks.description:
Develop an internal Learning & Development (L\&D) Academy module within the Aspio HR app to support employee onboarding, training courses, and skill development tracking.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Design and implement UI components for a course catalog, module lessons, and progress tracking indicators.

✅ Create admin capabilities to author, publish, and assign training materials/quizzes to specific roles or teams.

✅ Implement user tracking for completed modules, certifications, and onboarding milestones across mobile and web platforms.

tasks.subject: Implement KPI & Performance Tracking logic and dashboard views
tasks.description:
Build backend data pipelines and UI dashboard components to compute and render real-time staff metrics, auto-identify top performers, flag at-risk staff, handle multi-timeframe filters (Daily, Weekly, 3-Month), and calculate total revenue per service.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Implement database queries and backend services to compute revenue, reviews, and attendance metrics per staff member.

✅ Build dashboard backend/UI endpoints to aggregate metrics across Daily, Weekly, and 3-Month (Quarterly) windows.

✅ Develop threshold/flagging logic for Top Performers and At-Risk Staff based on performance KPIs and attendance logs.

✅ Display service-segmented revenue breakdowns on staff performance cards.

tasks.subject: Design UI/UX for Staff History & Review Mapping
tasks.description:
Design UI/UX for Staff History & Review Mapping, maintaining searchable booking histories per staff member and mapping incoming customer reviews directly to individual profiles and bookings.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Create searchable, filterable booking history ledger designs for staff profiles.

✅ Design review mapping interfaces connecting ratings and text feedback to specific staff profiles and appointment IDs.

✅ Ensure intuitive profile layouts for managing staff performance logs.

tasks.subject: Implement Customer-Staff Relationship Mapping metrics and tracking
tasks.description:
Implement tracking algorithms and data aggregation pipelines for customer-staff relationship metrics, including repeat client retention rates and preferred staff booking trends.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Calculate repeat client retention rates and customer-to-staff loyalty scores across booking transactions.

✅ Expose retention and preferred booking trend metrics via API endpoints.

✅ Display relationship metrics on customer and staff detail views in the management platform.

tasks.subject: Security & Access Control Configurations
tasks.description:
Design UI/UX configurations for role-based security & access control to safeguard sensitive staff data, performance metrics, and dashboard views.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Design permission configuration screens for assigning role-based access levels (Owner, Manager, Receptionist, Staff).

✅ Define restricted access UI states and locked views for protected dashboard areas.

✅ Provide clear visual feedback for role-restricted metrics and settings.

tasks.subject: Implement Staff Booking History & Review Mapping backend and UI
tasks.description:
Implement database schemas, queries, and UI components to log searchable staff booking history and link incoming customer reviews directly to staff profiles and booking IDs.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Store customer ratings and feedback tied directly to staff IDs and booking reference keys.

✅ Create optimized, searchable API endpoints for querying staff appointment history with filters.

✅ Expose mapped review records on individual staff profiles and booking detail views.

tasks.subject: Implement Security & Role-Based Access Control middleware for staff data
tasks.description:
Enforce role-based access control (RBAC) middleware and permission configurations to secure sensitive staff performance data, salary metrics, and admin dashboard views.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Apply RBAC middleware to protect sensitive staff KPI and review endpoints.

✅ Configure fine-grained access levels (e.g., Owner, Manager, Receptionist, Staff) restricting view and edit privileges.

✅ Ensure unauthorized role requests return appropriate HTTP 403 status responses and clean UI restricted states.

tasks.subject: Implement Quick Action Modals for Create Booking and Create Customer
tasks.description:
Build responsive quick-action modal overlays triggered directly from the main dashboard UI, supporting workflows for Create Booking and Create Customer with validation and state updates.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Implement modal component triggers on the main dashboard for Create Booking and Create Customer.

✅ Ensure form submission in modals creates the respective record via API and updates UI state dynamically.

✅ Handle input validation, error handling, and keyboard shortcuts/outside-click modal closing.

tasks.subject: Implement Daily Revenue Tracking with real-time updates and daily reset
tasks.description:
Implement backend services and real-time frontend indicators to track daily revenue, supporting dynamic updates on incoming payments and automated midnight counter resets.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Build backend aggregation service to calculate total accrued revenue for the current day.

✅ Implement real-time WebSocket/polling updates to refresh revenue totals dynamically on payment completion.

✅ Implement automated cron/timezone-aware reset logic to zero out daily revenue counters at the start of each day.

tasks.subject: Implement Staff Attendance Monitoring widget for receptionists
tasks.description:
Develop receptionist attendance monitoring interface showing real-time staff clock-in/out statuses, shift schedules, and availability badges on the main dashboard.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Build an at-a-glance staff attendance widget/view tailored for receptionists and managers.

✅ Display live status indicators (Clocked In, On Break, Off Duty, Late) synchronized with timekeeping logs.

✅ Provide quick action controls for receptionists to manually adjust or log attendance overrides when needed.

tasks.subject: Implement Petty Cash Tracking module and transaction logging
tasks.description:
: Implement petty cash transaction logging, category tracking, and balance management directly within the POS and Business application.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Build database schema and API endpoints for logging cash deposits, withdrawals, and expense categories.

✅ Create UI views/forms for cashiers and managers to quickly log petty cash receipts and notes.

✅ Generate audit trails and current petty cash balance summaries per shift/register.

tasks.subject: Update Visit Outcome Popup: Default ON, Remove Close Button, Add Owner "Don't ask again" Option
tasks.description:
Configure and update the Visit Outcome popup component to be enabled by default, remove the close (X) button, and add an owner-only "Don't ask again" control.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Ensure the Visit Outcome popup is toggled ON by default across salon/business workflows.

✅ Remove the close (X) button from the popup modal header to require an explicit action or outcome selection.

✅ Implement a "Don't ask again" toggle/setting visible and controllable strictly by users with Owner role/permissions.

tasks.subject: Build Staff Dashboard for individual team members
tasks.description:
Build a dedicated, role-tailored Staff Dashboard interface for team members across web and mobile platforms to view their personal performance metrics, daily schedules, assigned tasks, and quick actions.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Develop UI layout tailored for individual staff views displaying personal KPIs (upcoming bookings, completed services, tips/commissions).

✅ Render daily shift schedule, appointment queues, and real-time appointment status updates.

✅ Provide quick-action controls for logging clock-in/out, requesting leaves, and viewing customer notes for assigned appointments.

✅ Restrict staff view strictly to personal data and permissions using RBAC middleware.

tasks.subject: Extend Marketplace CF logic for codeless discounts and align auto/deal/coupon discount evaluation
tasks.description:
Extend Marketplace checkout and custom field (CF) logic to support link-based discounts without promo codes, integrate auto discounts with deals/coupons, and align Marketplace pricing logic.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Extend Custom Field (CF) logic on Marketplace to support code-less discount links and automated promotion application.

✅ Refactor discount evaluation engine so auto discounts, deal discounts, and coupon discounts co-exist and stack/calculate per defined priority rules.

✅ Align Marketplace checkout pipeline with backend auto discount engine to ensure consistent price calculation and real-time total updates.

✅ Validate fallback and error states for stacked or conflicting discount combinations across web and mobile checkout flows.

tasks.subject: Remove calendar right-side status panel to increase main calendar grid size
tasks.description:
Remove the side status panel (On Leave, Live, etc.) from the right side of the calendar interface, relying on summary cards for these status counts to maximize the primary calendar grid width and viewable area.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Remove the right sidebar listing staff statuses (On Leave, Live, etc.) from the calendar layout across web and mobile views.

✅ Ensure all status metrics previously shown in the sidebar are clearly accessible via top summary cards.

✅ Expand the main calendar grid component to utilize the freed UI space for improved visibility and readability.

tasks.subject: Refactor calendar header layout and clean up redundant UI controls
tasks.description:
Refactor the calendar view navigation bar by positioning Month/Week/Day view selectors directly below the Live indicators and removing non-essential or ambiguous header icons/badges.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Relocate Month, Week, and Day view toggles to the top section beneath the Live status bar.

✅ Identify and remove ambiguous header controls/icons that add clutter without clear utility.

✅ Ensure calendar header layout remains clean, responsive, and intuitive across desktop and mobile screens.

tasks.subject: Implement out-of-radius check-in approval and admin alert system
tasks.description:
Implement out-of-radius check-in and check-out approval workflows to ensure staff location compliance. Flag geofence violations prominently on the admin dashboard and trigger real-time notifications for manager/admin approval. Applies to staff shift timekeeping across web and mobile HRMS apps.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Detect staff check-in/out attempts occurring outside designated geofence radius boundaries.

✅ Trigger real-time notifications to admins and managers when an out-of-radius attempt occurs.

✅ Display prominent, visual flag alerts and quick-approval controls on the admin dashboard for pending out-of-radius timekeeping logs.

tasks.subject: Display active staff check-in status indicators on dashboard
tasks.description:
Display real-time active staff attendance indicators directly on the admin and receptionist dashboards, showing clear visual status badges for staff members who are currently checked in, checked out, or late for their shifts.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Display active check-in status indicators (e.g., Checked In, On Break, Not Checked In) per staff member on the main dashboard.

✅ Automatically sync status indicators in real time as staff check in or out via the mobile or web app.

✅ Highlight absent, late, or unverified staff statuses with distinct visual alerts for quick manager visibility.

tasks.subject: Implement hierarchy chat request and permission gating for leadership chats
tasks.description:
Implement a hierarchy request system for in-app chat that requires staff to send a permission request before opening direct messaging threads with executive leadership, enabling chat access only upon leadership approval.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Restrict direct messaging to executive leadership roles by requiring an explicit hierarchy chat request.

✅ Provide leadership users with request notifications and one-tap Accept or Decline controls.

✅ Enforce chat channel permissions so staff can send messages only after a request is accepted, maintaining a restricted state if denied or pending.

tasks.subject: Implement country-based default currency assignment during company setup
tasks.description:
Implement country-based default currency assignment during company creation, automatically propagating local currencies (SEK for Sweden, ETB/Birr for Ethiopia, and USD as default for others) across all company services, pricing, discounts, deals, and loyalty programs.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Automatically detect and assign default company currency based on selected country upon registration (SEK for Sweden, ETB for Ethiopia, USD default for others).

✅ Propagate and enforce the assigned company currency across all financial modules, including service prices, discounts, marketplace deals, gift cards, and loyalty balances.

✅ Ensure currency formatting and symbols render consistently across web, mobile POS, and HR interfaces without manual user configuration.

tasks.subject: Implement "Starting From" and duration-based pricing setup in Business app

✅ Implement frontend optimizations including code splitting, route-based lazy loading, image asset compression, and caching strategies.

✅ Optimize backend query fetching, indexing, and payload sizes, reducing initial dashboard load time to under 1.5 seconds.

tasks.subject: Connect payroll to the rest of HR (backend)
tasks.description:
Payroll should take employee, job, attendance, leave and pay data from the correct HR modules instead of its own copies. Every number must show where it came from, and unofficial or unapproved time and leave must not reach official payroll.

Acceptance criteria

✅ Payroll reads employee, job, attendance, leave and pay data from the correct HR modules
✅ Each payroll number (hours, days, leave, pay) records its source module and source record
✅ A clear audit trail shows where each number came from, and it can be opened from the payslip line
✅ Unofficial or unapproved attendance time is excluded from official payroll
✅ Unapproved leave is excluded from official payroll
✅ Excluded items are listed with the reason, so HR can see what was left out
✅ A change in an HR module is reflected in the next payroll calculation, unless the run inputs are frozen (see Task 13)
✅ Backend tests cover data pulled from each module and the exclusion of unapproved time and leave

tasks.subject: Salary history and locked payroll inputs (backend and frontend
tasks.description:
Support pay changes with start and end dates instead of only a "current salary". Freeze a run's inputs so HR edits made after the freeze don't silently change the run. Admins manage this on the Financial and Salary & bank screens.

Acceptance criteria

✅ Each employee can have several salary records, each with a start date and an optional end date
✅ Payroll uses the salary that is valid for the pay period, including mid-period changes
✅ Overlapping or conflicting salary dates are blocked with a clear error message
✅ Admins can add, edit and end salary records on the Financial screen and the Salary & bank screen
✅ The full salary history of an employee is visible, with who changed it and when
✅ When a run inputs are frozen, later HR edits do not change that run
✅ The run shows that its inputs are frozen and when they were frozen
✅ A frozen run can only be refreshed by an explicit, logged action by an authorized user
✅ Backend tests cover mid-period salary changes and edits made after the freeze

tasks.subject: Payroll periods and full run lifecycle (backend and frontend)
tasks.description:
Support monthly, biweekly, weekly and custom periods. Move each run through payment, bank submission, reconciliation and closed. A closed run can no longer be edited. Users choose the period when creating a run.

Acceptance criteria

✅ A run can be created for a monthly, biweekly, weekly or custom period
✅ The create-run screen has a period selector, and a custom period needs a start and end date
✅ A run cannot overlap another run for the same employees and period
✅ Run statuses follow the order: payment, bank submission, reconciliation, closed
✅ A run cannot skip a status, and each status change is logged with user and time
✅ A closed run cannot be edited, and the UI shows it as read-only
✅ Corrections to a closed run are only possible through a correction run (see Task 16)
✅ The current status is visible on the run list and on the run page
✅ Backend tests cover each period type and the blocked edits on closed runs

tasks.subject: Tax, pension and payroll rules that admins can configure (backend and frontend)
tasks.description:
Replace the hard-coded Ethiopia tax and pension settings with versioned rules. Support eligibility by grade, department and location, treatment of overtime and leave, and a deduction order. Admins get a rules screen instead of one-off buttons.

Acceptance criteria

✅ Tax and pension rates and brackets are stored as rules, not hard-coded
✅ Each rule has a version with an effective start date, and old versions are kept
✅ A payroll run uses the rule version that was valid for its period
✅ Rules can target eligibility by grade, department and location
✅ Admins can set how overtime and leave are treated in each rule
✅ Admins can set and change the order in which deductions are applied
✅ A rules screen lets admins view, add and edit rules and versions, and replaces the one-off buttons
✅ The Ethiopia rules that are in use today are migrated as the first rule version, and results match the current calculation
✅ Changes to rules are logged with user and time
✅ Backend tests cover version selection, eligibility and deduction order

tasks.subject: Loans, benefits and special payroll run types (backend and frontend)
tasks.description:
Bring loans, advances and benefits into the same payroll calculation. Add a what-if simulation, correction and retro runs that don't overwrite locked payslips, and a final settlement when someone leaves.

Acceptance criteria

✅ Loans, advances and benefits are included in the payroll calculation
✅ Loan and advance repayments are deducted automatically and the remaining balance is updated
✅ A what-if simulation can be run without saving or changing any payroll data
✅ A correction or retro run can be created for a past period
✅ A correction or retro run never overwrites a locked payslip and creates separate adjustment lines instead
✅ A final settlement run is available when an employee leaves, including remaining pay, leave payout and open loan balances
✅ Each special run type is clearly labeled on the run list and on the payslip
✅ Backend tests cover loans, simulation, retro runs and final settlemen

tasks.subject: Approvals, finance handoff, payslips and reports (backend and frontend)
tasks.description:
Add role-based approval with an exception list, GL posting and bank payment and reconciliation, employee payslip PDFs, and payroll reports and a dashboard. Add tests and short runbooks so the whole process can be audited from start to finish.

Acceptance criteria

✅ The user can view and edit the company's legal name, organisation number, address, contact details and VAT number
✅ Required fields are validated and changes are saved with confirmation

Fiscal periods

✅ The user can create fiscal years and periods (for example monthly)
✅ Periods can be opened and closed
✅ Periods cannot overlap, and posting to a closed period is blocked

Chart of accounts

✅ The user can create, edit, search and deactivate accounts
✅ Each account has a number, name, type and status
✅ Account numbers are unique
✅ An account that has transactions cannot be deleted

Dimensions

✅ The user can create dimensions (for example department, project, cost center) and their values
✅ Dimensions can be set as required or optional on accounts

Currencies

✅ The user can set the base currency and add other currencies
✅ Exchange rates can be entered manually
✅ Currency formatting is consistent across the system

Account mappings

✅ The user can map business events (for example sales, VAT, payments, discounts) to accounts
✅ Missing mappings are flagged clearly

Numbering

✅ The user can configure number series (prefix, starting number, length) per document or voucher type
✅ Numbers are generated automatically, are unique and have no gaps or duplicates

Transaction rules

✅ The user can define posting rules (for example required fields, balanced entries, allowed accounts)
✅ Rules are applied when a transaction is posted, with a clear error message if a rule is broken

tasks.subject: Deploy the backend to the Hetzner server
tasks.description:
Move the backend to run on the Hetzner server. This includes migrating the existing data, creating the deployment YAML file, and setting up CI/CD so that every release is deployed automatically.

Server setup

✅ The Hetzner server is set up and secured (firewall, SSH keys only, non-root user, automatic security updates)
✅ The backend runs on the server and is reachable through its domain over HTTPS
✅ Environment variables and secrets are stored securely and are not committed to the repository
✅ The backend restarts automatically after a crash or a server reboot

Data migration

✅ A full backup of the current database is taken before the migration starts
✅ All data is migrated to the Hetzner server
✅ Row counts and key records are checked and match between the old and new databases
✅ A rollback plan is written and tested
✅ The migration is run on a staging copy first, before production
✅ Any downtime is planned and communicated in advance

YAML file

✅ A deployment YAML file (for example Docker Compose or a CI workflow file) is created and committed to the repository
✅ The file defines the backend service, the database, environment variables, ports and volumes
✅ The deployment can be recreated from scratch using only this file and the documented secrets

CI/CD

✅ The pipeline runs automatically when code is pushed to the main branch (or the chosen release branch)
✅ The pipeline builds the backend, runs the tests and deploys to the Hetzner server only if the tests pass
✅ Database migrations run automatically as part of the deployment
✅ A failed deployment is reported and the previous working version stays running (or can be rolled back with one step)
✅ Deployment status is visible to the team (for example in Slack or GitHub)

tasks.subject: Design UI/UX for User Roles & Permissions in Accounting Module
tasks.description:
Design comprehensive UI/UX workflows for managing fine-grained user roles and permissions within the accounting module (e.g., Accountant, Auditor, Financial Manager, Billing Clerk). Include matrix views, granular permission toggles, and approval hierarchy settings.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Design role creation, editing, and assignment interface layouts tailored to accounting workflows.

✅ Create interactive permission matrix grid with granular access levels (Read, Write, Approve, Delete, Export) per accounting domain (GL, AP, AR, Tax, Reports).

✅ Build UI components for dual-control/approval hierarchy settings for sensitive financial actions.

tasks.subject: Implement No-Show Appointment Tracking & Calendar Warning Indicators
tasks.description:
Implement customer appointment no-show status tracking and visual calendar indicators for uncollected fee reminders upon subsequent bookings.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Add 'No-Show' status action to appointment management views and update customer profile history.

✅ Display a prominent visual indicator/badge (e.g., warning symbol or flag) on future calendar appointments for customers with past no-shows.

✅ Include a detailed outstanding fee alert/banner on appointment check-in/POS checkout views prompting staff to collect missed appointment fees.

tasks.subject: Add time-of-day configuration to recurring discounts
tasks.description:
Enhance recurring discount rules in AMP to allow users to specify active start/end time windows for recurring discounts (e.g., happy hour schedules, daily peak/off-peak windows).

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Add time picker controls (start time and end time) to the recurring discount creation and edit interface.

✅ Update backend discount evaluation logic and database schemas to enforce time-of-day restrictions for recurring rules.

✅ Validate time selection inputs and ensure accurate execution across POS checkout and Marketplace booking engines.

tasks.subject: Build Campaign creation page for exclusive link-based service discounts
tasks.description:
Design and build a Campaign creation page in AMP allowing business owners to generate exclusive link-based service discounts, select from pre-designed promotional templates, and configure discount parameters.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Create the Campaign Builder UI with template selection (discount banners, email/link landing pages, promotional themes).

✅ Implement campaign parameters configuration (discount type, value, expiry date, usage limit, eligible services).

✅ Build unique shareable link generation logic connected to backend campaign tracking and analytics.

tasks.subject: Build campaign page for exclusive link-based service discounts
tasks.description:
Build a dedicated landing page offering specific service discounts accessible exclusively to customers who arrive via unique campaign tracking links.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Create a responsive campaign landing page featuring target service discounts.

✅ Restrict discount access and offer visibility strictly to users arriving via campaign URL parameters/links.

✅ Verify campaign link tracking, discount redemption at checkout, and analytics conversion tracking.

tasks.subject: Build Campaign creation page for exclusive link-based service discounts
tasks.description:
Design and build a Campaign creation page in AMP allowing business owners to generate exclusive link-based service discounts, select from pre-designed promotional templates, and configure discount parameters.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Create the Campaign Builder UI with template selection (discount banners, email/link landing pages, promotional themes).

✅ Implement campaign parameters configuration (discount type, value, expiry date, usage limit, eligible services).

✅ Build unique shareable link generation logic connected to backend campaign tracking and analytics.

tasks.subject: Export Review System Data
tasks.description:
Add functionality to export review data from the review system. Business owners and admins should be able to export reviews related to staff members, companies, and bookings for reporting, analysis, and backup purposes.

Requirements:

Backend (Nest):
Create export endpoints for review data.
Support filters by:
Company
Staff
Booking
Date range
Rating
Generate export files in CSV and Excel formats.
Frontend (Business App):
Add Export button in review management screens.
Allow selection of export filters.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Reviews can be exported by company, staff, and booking.
✅ CSV and Excel formats supported.
✅ Filters work correctly.
✅ QA confirms export accuracy.

tasks.subject: Add Business Package/bundle Setup and display bundled packages in Marketplace booking flow
tasks.description:
Implement custom package setup for businesses, allowing admins to group multiple services into bundle packages, set package pricing, and expose these packages directly within the Marketplace booking flow for customers.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Create a Package Management UI in the business settings allowing owners/admins to create service bundles, set total package pricing, and define terms.

✅ Integrate service packages into the Marketplace booking flow, allowing customers to select, customize, and book service packages.

✅ Update backend data models and booking engines to handle bundled service scheduling, staff assignment, and invoice generation.

tasks.subject: Restore multiple deleted services, booking, staff...
tasks.description:
Update business app interfaces to allow business owners to restore multiple deleted services at once from the Trash.

Acceptance Criteria:
✅ Add checkboxes to each service in Services > Trash so multiple services can be selected
✅ Add a "Restore selected" action that restores all selected services in one step
✅ Show a clear confirmation message after restoring, listing how many services were brought back

tasks.subject: Add tip input functionality for receptionist and admin checkout flows
tasks.description:
Implement a tip input feature on the POS / receptionist checkout interface, allowing receptionists and admins to add and record customer tip amounts during checkout or bill settlement.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Add an 'Add Tip' button and numeric input control to the receptionist/admin checkout and payment summary screens.

✅ Support quick-select tip percentages (e.g., 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%) alongside custom tip amount entry.

✅ Attach recorded tip amounts to transaction ledger entries, and employee tipping summaries in the NestJS backend.

tasks.subject: Add service-specific availability blocking for staff in business app
tasks.description:
Implement fine-grained service availability blocking in the business app, allowing staff or admins to temporarily block specific services for specified date/time ranges without affecting overall staff availability or other services.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Add service-specific availability override controls in the staff scheduling / availability calendar.

✅ Allow selecting specific service(s) and date ranges (e.g., block Service X for 1 month) with reason notes.

✅ Update booking engine and Marketplace availability algorithms to exclude blocked services while keeping non-blocked services available for booking.

tasks.subject: Website AI Integration for Auto-Filling Simple Website Content
tasks.description:
Implement an AI-assisted website setup feature that allows users to input basic business information, enabling the AI to automatically fill in the remaining content, sections, and template blanks.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Develop the AI auto-fill engine for website content generation

✅ Design user interface for submitting initial business details

✅ Test the auto-fill accuracy and integration within the site builder flow

tasks.subject: Fix Timer & Check-In/Check-Out Widget UI & Placement
tasks.description:
Audit, refactor, and polish the Timer and Check-In/Check-Out widget UI layout, responsive positioning, and user interactions across desktop and mobile headers/dashboards.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Redesign Timer and Check-In/Check-Out widget UI to align with the AMP design system.

✅ Fix layout collision, alignment, and z-index issues across dynamic header and dashboard grid placements.

✅ Validate timer clock interactions, status transitions (Checked-In, On Break, Checked-Out), and state persistence.

tasks.subject: Fix Blank Page Disappearance Bug During Cross-Module Navigation
tasks.description:
Investigate and resolve routing/state management issue where navigating between modules (e.g., from Project Management to Dashboard) causes module views or sidebar navigation items to blank out or unmount entirely.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Reproduce and isolate SPA routing, view-mounting, and sidebar layout state bugs during cross-module navigation.

✅ Fix state retention/react-router logic preventing page unmounting and missing DOM tree elements.

✅ Ensure seamless transition and persistent navigation state between Project Management, Executive Dashboard, and other AMP modules.

tasks.subject: Research Conversational Booking Flow
tasks.description:
Let customers complete a booking inside the chat.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ The chatbot collects service, staff preference, date and time, and customer details, and confirms them before booking.
✅ Creates the booking through the existing booking API with the same validation as the normal flow.
✅ Handles unavailable slots by suggesting alternatives; supports rescheduling and cancellation.
✅ Confirmation message and email or notification after booking.
✅ Edge cases tested: double-booking, past dates, and timezone differences.
✅ Tested and merged into develop.

tasks.subject: Refine Forms and Input Validation Across Manage Submodules
tasks.description:
Refine form layouts and implement strict input validation rules across all Manage submodules (Organization, Locations, Services, Staff, Roles, and Settings).

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Standardize input field styling, labels, helper text, and error states across all Manage forms.

✅ Implement robust client-side and server-side validation rules (required fields, format checks, numeric bounds, custom regex).

✅ Ensure inline error messages, toast notifications, and focus management work seamlessly on form submission.

tasks.subject: System and Permission Configuration
tasks.description:
Set up the business settings, user roles, and database structure that everything else builds on.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ An Owner/Admin can save the business profile (name, address, phone, logo), and the saved details show on the screen afterwards
✅ A currency can be selected, and all prices in the system use it
✅ Payment methods (for example Cash, Card, Mobile Money) can be added, enabled, and disabled
✅ Four roles exist: Owner/Admin, Seller/Cashier, Inventory Manager, and Viewer
✅ Each role only sees the screens and actions it is allowed (for example a Viewer cannot edit, and a Cashier cannot change stock)
✅ Permissions are checked on the backend, so a blocked action fails even if called directly
✅ Database tables exist for products, stock balances, users, and stock movem

tasks.subject: Product Catalog Management
tasks.description:
Build the screens to list, register, and edit products.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ The Product List shows name, SKU, category, cost, price, and stock, and supports search and pagination
✅ The Register Product form saves name, SKU, optional barcode, category, purchase cost, and selling price
✅ An existing product can be opened, edited, and saved
✅ A duplicate SKU or barcode is rejected with a clear message
✅ Cost and price cannot be negative, and required fields cannot be empty
✅ After saving, the product appears in the list without a page refresh

tasks.subject: Stock Balances and Opening Balances
tasks.description:
Show how much stock exists for each item, and record the starting quantity.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ The Stock Balances screen shows on-hand quantity, available-to-sell quantity, and minimum reorder threshold for each product
✅ An opening balance can be entered when a product is registered
✅ The opening balance creates a stock movement entry (type, quantity, date, user), so it can be traced
✅ The opening balance and reorder threshold cannot be negative
✅ The stock balance matches the total of all stock movements for that product

tasks.subject: Sales and Checkout Interface
tasks.description:
Build the main screen where a cashier builds a sale.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ A product can be found by name, code, or barcode scan
✅ The selling price is filled in automatically when a product is added
✅ Adding a product that is already in the cart increases its quantity, rather than creating a second line
✅ Quantities can be changed and lines can be removed, and the totals update straight away
✅ A customer can be logged on the sale (name or phone)
✅ A payment method must be selected before the sale can be completed
✅ Out-of-stock items cannot be added, or show a clear warning

tasks.subject: Transaction Confirmation and Automated Stock Deduction
tasks.description:
Complete the sale and update stock automatically.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ Available stock is checked when the sale is confirmed, and the sale is blocked if stock is not enough
✅ A unique sale reference is generated for every sale
✅ Payment method, amount paid, and change are saved with the sale
✅ Sold quantities are deducted from stock balances automatically
✅ A stock movement of type "sale" is recorded for each sold item
✅ If any step fails, nothing is saved, so stock and sale records never get out of sync
✅ Two sales at the same time cannot sell the same last item twice

tasks.subject: Receipt Generation
tasks.description:
Create receipts that are ready to print.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ The receipt shows business info, cashier ID, sale reference, date and time, items, quantities, prices, discounts, total, and payment details
✅ The receipt prints correctly on standard paper and on thermal printers (58 mm and 80 mm)
✅ A receipt can be printed right after a sale is completed
✅ Long item names and many items do not break the layout

tasks.subject: Sales History
tasks.description:
Let cashiers and managers look back at past sales.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ Sales can be searched by sale reference or customer
✅ Sales can be filtered by date, payment method, seller, and status
✅ Opening a sale shows its itemized record
✅ A receipt can be reprinted from any past sale
✅ Viewing or reprinting never changes the original transaction data
✅ Cashiers see only what their role allows, and managers see all sales

tasks.subject: Live Operations Dashboard
tasks.description:
Build the main screen showing how the business is doing right now.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ Cards show today's total sales, active product count, and total inventory cost value
✅ Low-stock and out-of-stock alerts list the affected items
✅ Quick-action shortcuts (for example New Sale, Add Product, Stock Balances) open the right screens
✅ Numbers come from saved transactions and match the Sales History
✅ Values refresh after a new sale without a manual page reload

tasks.subject: Stock Level Reporting
tasks.description:
Automatically flag items that need restocking.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ An item is flagged Low Stock when its quantity is at or below its reorder threshold
✅ An item is flagged Out of Stock when its quantity is 0
✅ The report can be filtered by status (All, Low Stock, Out of Stock)
✅ Flags update automatically after a sale or a stock change

tasks.subject: Financial Inventory Valuation
tasks.description:
Show what the stock is worth, based on what it cost.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ Value is calculated from unit purchase cost, not selling price
✅ One costing method (weighted-average or FIFO) is used consistently, and it is shown on the report
✅ Value is shown per item and as a grand total
✅ The grand total matches the total inventory cost value on the Dashboard

tasks.subject: Sales Performance Analytics and Shared Export
tasks.description:
Report on sales and let managers export the results.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ Daily, weekly, monthly, and custom date range views are available
✅ The report shows gross sales, net sales, average sale value, transaction count, and payment method breakdown
✅ Search and filters work and update the figures
✅ The report exports to CSV, Excel, and PDF
✅ Exported files match what is shown on screen, including the applied filters
✅ Totals match the Sales History for the same period

tasks.subject: Backend (Nest): Staff-stats list API and staff detail API
tasks.description:
Build two separate endpoints. The list returns every staff member with summary numbers (stats, metrics, SAR) in one request. The detail returns the full Nest bookings for one staff member and is called only when that staff member is opened.

✅ A list endpoint returns all staff for the business, each with stats, metrics, and SAR amounts
✅ The list numbers are calculated on the backend with an aggregated query, so the number of queries stays the same however many staff there are (no N+1)
✅ The list returns summary fields only, with no full booking records
✅ The list supports pagination, search, and a date range filter
✅ A separate detail endpoint takes a staff ID and returns that staff member's full Nest bookings (date, time, client, service, status, SAR amount)
✅ Detail bookings are paginated and support a date range filter
✅ The totals on the detail endpoint match the numbers on the list for the same staff member and date range
✅ A staff ID from another business, or an invalid ID, returns a clear error
✅ Both endpoints are limited to authorized business users and their own business
✅ Amounts are returned in SAR with consistent formatting and roundin

tasks.subject: Business mobile: Staff list and staff detail screens
tasks.description:
Show all staff with their summary numbers on one screen, and open a staff member to see their full Nest bookings. The list and detail use different endpoints, so the list never loads bookings.

✅ The list screen calls only the staff-stats list endpoint, once per load, with no booking requests per staff member
✅ Each list row shows the staff name, stats, metrics, and SAR amount
✅ Tapping a staff row opens the detail screen, which calls the detail endpoint only when it opens
✅ The detail screen shows the full Nest bookings with key details and SAR amounts, using pagination or infinite scroll
✅ Search, date range filter, and pull-to-refresh work on the list, and the date range filter works on the detail
✅ The numbers on the detail screen match the numbers on the list for the same staff member
✅ Loading, empty, and error states are shown on both screens, with a retry option
✅ Amounts are formatted in SAR and follow the app language
✅ Both screens work on small and large phone screens

tasks.subject: Restaurant: open the PDF menu when there is no link
tasks.description:
When a restaurant has no menu link, the menu button should open the uploaded PDF menu.People should be able to see the menu (image or PDF) on the page without downloading a file.

✅ If a menu link exists, the button opens the link
✅ If there is no link but a PDF menu is uploaded, the button opens the PDF menu
✅ If neither exists, the button is hidden or shows a clear message
✅ Checked on desktop and mobile, in Swedish and English

✅ The menu opens in a preview on the page, with no download needed
✅ The person can zoom and scroll through all pages
✅ There is a close button, and download is a separate optional button
✅ Checked on desktop and mobile, in Swedish and English

tasks.subject: Working hours: show times in 24-hour format with :00
tasks.description:
Working hours now show "1:00 AM – 5:00 PM". They should show as "10:00 – 00:00".

✅ Working hours use the 24-hour format (for example 09:00 – 17:00) 
✅ The same format is used everywhere working hours appear (profile, schedule, bookings)
✅ Checked in Swedish and English

tasks.subject: Weekly calendar: make the calendar selectable, not only the days
tasks.description:
Today only the days (Mon–Sun) can be selected. The weekly calendar itself should also be selectable, so working hours can be set for each day.

✅ Each day in the weekly calendar can be selected and edited
✅ Working hours (start and end time) can be set per day, with a different time for each day
✅ Several days can be selected at once and given the same hours
✅ A day can be set as day off
✅ Selected days and times are clearly highlighted, and day names follow the selected language
✅ Changes are saved and still shown after reloading the page
✅ Checked on desktop and mobile

tasks.subject: Investigate and fix slow loading
tasks.description:
Some pages load slowly. First find out why, then fix it.

✅ The slowest pages and requests are measured, and the cause is written in the task
✅ The main pages (Dashboard, Staff, Attendance, Report) load in under 3 seconds on a normal connection (the target can be changed by the team)
✅ A loading indicator is shown while data loads
✅ Before and after timings are attached to the ta

tasks.subject: Wrong currency displayed throughout the booking flow-AI-bot
tasks.description:
Prices are shown in $ (and in some places €) instead of the business's currency (SEK/kr). This affects the service list, "Selected services", the booking summary (subtotal, VAT, total) and the AI assistant.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ All prices in the service list use the business's configured currency.
✅ "Selected services" shows the correct currency.
✅ The summary (subtotal, VAT, total) shows the correct currency.
✅ The AI assistant shows prices in the same currency as the rest of the flow.
✅ VAT and subtotal are calculated and rounded correctly for the currency.
✅ No hardcoded currency symbols remain in the codebase.

tasks.subject: AI assistant shows a different business than the one selected
tasks.description:
When the assistant is opened from the booking flow, it shows a different business than the one the user selected. The business name is also shown as a recommendation instead of as the current selection.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ The assistant always shows the same business as the booking flow.
✅ The selected business is displayed as the current selection, not as a recommendation.
✅ Recommendations only appear when no business is selected.
✅ The business stays consistent between the assistant, the booking flow and the summary.

✅ The business name is also included in the assistant's messages (e.g. "You're booking at {Business name}").

tasks.subject: Same available times shown for every day
tasks.description:
The same time slots are shown regardless of which day is selected. A slot that is already booked (11:30, greyed out) appears as unavailable on every day.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ Each day shows its own available and booked slots.
✅ A booked slot is only blocked on its own date.
✅ Availability reflects the selected staff member and the service duration.
✅ A loading state is shown when switching days, and stale slots are cleared.
✅ "First available" returns the actual earliest slot.

tasks.subject: Confusing assistant copy and weak "not confirmed" message
tasks.description:
The assistant's texts are confusing.
The messages "The time is held while you review — the booking is not confirmed" and "The booking is not confirmed until you press Confirm" are small, grey and placed at the bottom, so users miss them before booking.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ Assistant texts are short, clear and reviewed for consistent tone.
✅ The "not confirmed" notice is visible without scrolling, directly above the Confirm button.
✅ The notice uses an icon and meets contrast requirements (WCAG AA).
✅ The hold duration is shown if a timer exists.
✅ A new user understands the booking isn't complete until Confirm is pressed (verified in a quick usability check).

tasks.subject: Wrong year (2025) displayed in date picker and summary
tasks.description:
The date picker header shows "October 2025" and the summary shows "Mon, Oct 26, 2025". The year should be 2026. The weekdays and dates are already correct for 2026, so only the displayed year is wrong.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ The date picker header shows the correct month and year (October 2026).
✅ The summary shows the correct full date (Mon, Oct 26, 2026).
✅ The confirmation shows the same date as the summary.
✅ The year updates correctly when the user browses to another month or across New Year.
✅ The selected time in the picker matches the time in the summary and confirmation.
✅ Timezone differences don't shift the date or time.

tasks.subject: Send a confirmation email after booking
tasks.description:
After the user presses Confirm, no confirmation email is sent. The user should receive an email with the booking details so they have a record of it.Email should include:

Business name and address
Service(s), staff member, date, time and duration
Total price with VAT in the correct currency
Booking reference number
Links or instructions to change or cancel the booking
Contact details for the business

Acceptance criteria:

✅ A confirmation email is sent automatically after a successful booking.
✅ No email is sent if the booking fails or is not confirmed.
✅ The email contains the business name, services, staff, date, time, duration and total.
✅ Date, time, currency and year match exactly what was shown in the summary (see Tasks 1 and 4).
✅ The email is sent in the same language as the booking flow.
✅ The assistant shows a message such as "Confirmation sent to {email}" after booking.
✅ A failed email is retried and logged, and the booking stays valid.
✅ The email renders correctly on mobile and in common email clients.

tasks.subject: Salong Alegeo gets logged out of Aspio Business every time he leaves the page
tasks.description:
Salong Alegeo is logged out of Aspio Business every time he leaves the page and has to log in again. This is a repeat report that has not been solved yet. We first need to find out why it happens, then fix it so the session stays active.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ The root cause is identified and documented in the task (what, why, and since when).
✅ The issue is reproduced before the fix and verified as fixed afterwards.
✅ Salong Alegeo stays logged in after leaving the page, switching tabs and closing and reopening the browser.
✅ The session persists on the customer's actual device and browser (including mobile if relevant).
✅ Token refresh works, and the user is only logged out after a defined period of inactivity or after pressing Log out.
✅ Cookie and storage settings are correct for production (Secure, SameSite, domain and expiry).
✅ No other users are logged out or affected by the change.
✅ Auth errors and unexpected logouts are logged, so similar issues are easier to trace in the future.

tasks.subject: Separate regenerate for each website field
tasks.description:
The website builder only has one regenerate for everything. Each field should have its own regenerate, and the number of regenerations should be limited.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ Each field (e.g. headline, description, about) has its own regenerate button.
✅ Regenerating one field doesn't change the other fields.
✅ Regenerations are limited (e.g. X per field or per day, to be decided).
✅ The user sees how many regenerations are left, and a clear message when the limit is reached.

tasks.subject: Remove "Help me choose" from the AI chatbot booking flow
tasks.description:
Remove the "Hjälp mig välja" option from the AI chatbot's start screen.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ "Hjälp mig välja" is no longer shown in the chatbot.
✅ The remaining options ("Hitta en tjänst", "Kolla lediga tider") still work and the layout looks correct.
✅ No dead code or broken flow is left behind.

tasks.subject: Slow loading on the mobile website
tasks.description:
The website loads slowly on mobile.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ The cause is identified (e.g. image size, scripts, API calls).
✅ The page loads noticeably faster on mobile (target: under 3 seconds on 4G).
✅ Lighthouse mobile performance score is measured before and after.

tasks.subject: Company not found" on the website
tasks.description:
The website shows "Company not found" instead of the company's page.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ The cause is found and documented (e.g. wrong slug/ID, missing data, unpublished site).
✅ The company page loads correctly for the affected company.
✅ Other companies are not affected.

tasks.subject: Fix slow loading overall
tasks.description:
Loading is slow across the platform (marketplace, website, booking flow). Find the main bottlenecks and fix them. This includes Tasks 10 and 13.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ The slowest pages and requests are measured and listed.
✅ The main bottlenecks are fixed (e.g. caching, image optimization, slow queries).
✅ Loading times are measured before and after.
✅ Pages feel fast on both desktop and mobile.

tasks.subject: Loading is slow on my reviews
tasks.description:
Loading reviews makes the marketplace slow.

Acceptance criteria:

✅ The cause is identified (e.g. loading all reviews at once, slow query).
✅ Reviews load with pagination or lazy loading.
