tasks.subject: Products: Stock Balances
tasks.description:
Shows how many units of each product can be sold right now.

✅ Shows name, code, on-hand, reserved, available-to-sell, minimum stock, status and last movement date
✅ Status is In Stock, Low Stock or Out of Stock
✅ Updates right after every confirmed sale
✅ Quantities cannot be edited here, corrections go through stock adjustment
✅ Without reservations, available-to-sell equals on-hand

tasks.subject: Sales & Checkout
tasks.description:
The main screen where a seller completes a sale without extra forms.

✅ Search by name, SKU or barcode and add products to the cart
✅ Price loads automatically, quantity can be changed, and line and grand totals are correct
✅ Adding the same product again increases the quantity on the same line
✅ Customer name or “Walk-in customer”, and an enabled payment method, can be selected
✅ Selling more than the available stock is blocked
✅ Confirm Sale saves once (a double click or retry does not create two sales), creates a unique sale reference, deducts the exact quantities and records stock movements
✅ If saving fails, stock is not reduced
✅ After success, the receipt is offered and a fresh checkout opens

tasks.subject: Receipt
tasks.description:
A receipt after every confirmed sale.

✅ Shows business details, sale reference, date and time, customer, seller, items (quantity, unit price, line total), subtotal, discount, total, payment method and status, and footer message
✅ Can be printed, downloaded and reprinted from Sales History
✅ Fits standard paper and thermal printers
✅ Uses real sale values, and old receipts keep the price that was charged

tasks.subject: Sales History
tasks.description:
A searchable record of every confirmed sale.

✅ Search by sale reference or customer name
✅ Filter by date range, payment method, seller and status
✅ Open a sale to see items, payment, totals, who sold it and when
✅ Reprint the receipt
✅ Completed sales cannot be edited, mistakes go through a reversal or return and the original is kept

tasks.subject: Reports: Stock Level, Inventory Valuation and Sales Performance
tasks.description:
Three reports made automatically from existing product, stock and sales data.

✅ Stock Level: code, name, category, on-hand, reserved, available, minimum and status. Low Stock is at or below minimum and above zero, Out of Stock is zero or less
✅ Inventory Valuation: quantity × inventory cost (never selling price), total value, and products with no cost are flagged
✅ Sales Performance: daily, weekly, monthly and custom range, with gross sales, discounts, returns, net sales, transactions, units, average sale, payment method summary and best sellers
✅ Sales dates use the business time zone, and voided sales are excluded
✅ All reports: search, filter, sort, export to Excel/CSV, print or save as PDF, show period and generation date, empty state, and access by permission

tasks.subject: Settings & Users
tasks.description:
The minimum settings needed to run Phase 1

✅ Business profile, currency, payment methods and receipt message can be set
✅ Roles: Owner/Admin (everything), Seller/Cashier (checkout, sales history, receipts), Inventory Manager (products, prices, stock view), Viewer (read-only)
✅ One person can have several roles
✅ Price overrides, sale reversals and stock corrections are restricted and logged

tasks.subject: Test: end-to-end check
tasks.description:
Test that the whole Phase 1 flow works from product to receipt before the milestone is closed.

✅ Register a product with a unique code and a valid price
✅ Find the product at checkout by name, code and barcode
✅ Add two or more products, and the prices load automatically
✅ Change quantities, and the line totals and grand total update correctly
✅ Make a sale with a customer name and a sale as Walk-in customer
✅ Select a payment method and check the payment details
✅ Confirm the sale and get a unique sale reference
✅ Each product’s stock decreases by exactly the quantity sold
✅ Open the receipt and check the details and totals
✅ Find the sale in Sales History and reopen or reprint the receipt
✅ Click Confirm Sale twice quickly, and only one sale is saved
✅ Change a product’s price, and the old sale and receipt still show the old price
✅ Test with a seller, an inventory manager and a viewer, and each can only do what their role allows

tasks.subject: Understand the POS codebase and prepare API documentation
tasks.description:
Learn how the POS codebase works, so API documentation can start in the next milestone.

✅ The main modules, folders and how they connect are written down in a short overview
✅ The list of API endpoints is made (method, path, what it does) and grouped by module
✅ For each endpoint, the request fields, response fields and error responses are noted
✅ Which endpoints need a signed-in user, and which roles can use them, is noted
✅ Unclear or missing parts are written down as questions for the team
✅ The documentation format is chosen (for example OpenAPI or Swagger) and agreed with the team
✅ One module is documented in full as an example for the rest

tasks.subject: POS: Cashier reports
tasks.description:
Reports that show the work of each cashier.

✅ The report shows each cashier’s sales, using confirmed sales only
✅ It can be filtered by date range and cashier
✅ Dates use the business’s local time zone
✅ It can be exported or printed
✅ Only users with permission can open it
✅ Checked in Swedish and English

tasks.subject: POS: Article reports
tasks.description:
Reports that show how each article (product) sells.

✅ The report shows quantity sold and sales value for each article
✅ It can be filtered by date range and category
✅ Articles that did not sell are handled clearly
✅ It can be exported or printed
✅ Only users with permission can open it
✅ Checked in Swedish and English

tasks.subject: POS: Purchase receipts
tasks.description:
Receipts for purchases, so each purchase has a record that can be opened and printed.

✅ A purchase receipt is created for each confirmed purchase
✅ It shows the business details, reference, date and time, items, quantities, prices and totals
✅ It can be printed, downloaded and reopened later
✅ It uses the real values of the purchase
✅ Checked in Swedish and English

tasks.subject: POS: Journal
tasks.description:
Work on the Journal feature.

✅ Journal entries can be created and viewed
✅ Each entry shows date, description, accounts and amounts
✅ Debit and credit totals must match, or the entry cannot be saved
✅ Entries can be searched and filtered by date range
✅ Saved entries cannot be silently edited, and changes are recorded
✅ Only users with permission can use it
✅ Checked in Swedish and English

tasks.subject: Business Web App: enforce company access and remove the legacy proxy
tasks.description:
Check on the server that the user belongs to the company before any privileged route reads data, and remove the old proxy endpoints.

✅ Privileged routes (for example marketing-test-sms) call assertAnyCompanyAccess(companyId) on the server before any Admin SDK query
✅ All privileged routes are listed and checked, not only marketing-test-sms
✅ A signed-in user from another company gets a 403 and no data is read
✅ A request without a valid sign-in gets a 401
✅ rest-api-proxy and other legacy proxy endpoints are deleted, and nothing in the app still calls them
✅ Tested with a user from the company, a user from another company and no user

tasks.subject: Marketplace Web App: remove the open booking-proxy and require sign-in on get/cancel
tasks.description:
Nobody should be able to read or cancel a booking through an open proxy.

✅ booking-proxy is deleted, and nothing in the app still calls it
✅ The get and cancel booking routes require a valid Firebase ID token
✅ The uid is set on the server from the verified token, never from the request body or query
✅ A user can only get or cancel their own bookings
✅ A missing, invalid or expired token gets a 401, and another user’s booking gets a 403 or 404
✅ Tested with the owner of the booking, another user and no user

tasks.subject: Business Mobile App: remove INTERNAL_SERVICE_SECRET from the app and use Firebase ID tokens
tasks.description:
The secret is shipped inside the Flutter app assets, so anyone can extract it. Replace it with the signed-in user’s token.

✅ INTERNAL\_SERVICE\_SECRET is not in the app assets, source, build config or the built app (checked by unpacking a release build)
✅ The app sends the Firebase ID token on every endpoint call
✅ The backend FirebaseAuthGuard validates the token and checks the user’s company role
✅ The old secret is rotated, because it has already shipped inside the app
✅ Old app versions that still use the secret are handled (forced update or a short grace period), and the old method is turned off afterwards
✅ Tested with a user who has the right role, a user with the wrong role and no user

tasks.subject: Web apps: add the pr-quality.yml workflow and quality gates
tasks.description:
Block merges of the web apps unless lint, typecheck, tests, smoke tests and Lighthouse pass.

✅ pr-quality.yml runs lint, typecheck and unit tests on every pull request
✅ Merging is blocked when any check fails (required status checks)
✅ Playwright smoke tests run against the Vercel Preview URL
✅ The smoke tests fail if the preview URL is missing or points to localhost
✅ Lighthouse CI runs, and the passing scores are written down in the task
✅ Done in each web repository (Business Web App and Marketplace Web App)
✅ How to run the checks locally is written down

tasks.subject: Mobile apps: add the PR quality workflow
tasks.description:
Block merges of the mobile apps unless format, analyze, tests and security rules pass.

✅ The PR workflow runs format, analyze and unit tests
✅ A security rules emulator job runs and fails the PR if a rule test fails
✅ Merging is blocked when any job fails (required status checks)
✅ Done in each mobile repository
✅ How to run the checks locally is written down

tasks.subject: Mobile apps: build releases through Fastlane with protected signing secret
tasks.description:
Release builds should be repeatable and signed without secrets in the repository.

✅ Release builds run through Fastlane
✅ Signing secrets are stored only in protected GitHub Environments, with required approvers
✅ No signing secret is in the repository or printed in the build logs
✅ Only approved branches or tags can use the protected environment
✅ A release build cannot start while the PR quality checks fail
✅ A test release is built for Android and iOS

tasks.subject: Booking Backend: require green CI before deploy and add health endpoints
tasks.description:
Nothing is deployed unless the tests pass, and the platform can see whether the service is alive and ready.

✅ CI runs disposable PostgreSQL migrations, Jest and the E2E suites
✅ Deployment is blocked unless every CI job is green
✅ /health/live returns OK when the app is running
✅ /health/ready checks Postgres and Redis, and returns a failure (for example 503) when either is down
✅ The health endpoints do not show secrets or internal details
✅ The deployment platform uses these endpoints as probes
✅ Tested by stopping Postgres and Redis

tasks.subject: Remove the “Edit” button and open Staff and Services directly in edit mode
tasks.description:
Users get confused by the Edit button. When someone opens a staff member or a service, the page should already be editable. The Edit button is removed and the page works like a normal form with a Publish button.

Acceptance Criteria

✅ Clicking a staff member opens the page in edit mode right away.
✅ Clicking a service opens the page in edit mode right away.
✅ The “Edit” button is removed from the Staff Details and Service pages.
✅ “Upload photo” and all fields are visible and editable on load.
✅ Publish (and Preview) still work as before.
✅ Works the same on desktop and mobile.

tasks.subject: Keyboard is always visible in the business app (mobile)
tasks.description:
In the mobile business app, the keyboard stays open on screens like Redigera assistent (booking rules, time fields). The first time field seems to be auto-focused, so the keyboard covers the screen and the user can’t see or reach the rest of the form.

Acceptance Criteria

✅ No input is auto-focused when a page opens, so the keyboard does not appear automatically.
✅ The keyboard only opens when the user taps an input.
✅ The keyboard closes when the user taps outside the field or scrolls.
✅ Time dropdowns (e.g. “Första pass”) can be selected without the keyboard blocking the view.
✅ Tested on iOS and Android.

tasks.subject: Photo upload and Publish fails in Safari (laptop)
tasks.description:
In Safari on laptop, when Sonny uploads a profile photo and clicks Publish, Safari shows the warning “From business.aspio.io: Are you sure you want to leave this page?” with Stay on Page / Leave Page. Choosing Leave Page takes him to the “Åtkomst nekad” screen, and the photo is not saved. The same flow works in Chrome, so it is likely a Safari-specific issue with the unsaved-changes warning or the redirect after Publish.

Acceptance Criteria

✅ Uploading a photo and clicking Publish in Safari shows no “Are you sure you want to leave this page?” warning.
✅ The unsaved-changes warning only appears when the user actually leaves with unsaved changes, not when saving.
✅ After Publish, the user stays on the page or returns to the staff list, never to “Åtkomst nekad”.
✅ The new photo is saved and visible after reopening the profile.
✅ The same flow works in Chrome and Firefox.
✅ If an error happens, a clear message is shown and the user is not logged out.

tasks.subject: Cannot upload a staff photo from a phone
tasks.description:
Adding a picture to a staff profile works on laptop but not from a phone. Users need to be able to upload a photo from their phone camera or gallery.

Acceptance Criteria

✅ Tapping “Upload photo” on mobile lets the user choose from gallery or take a photo.
✅ Large phone photos (e.g. HEIC/JPEG, several MB) upload correctly.
✅ The photo is saved after Publish and shows in the staff profile.
✅ Works on iOS (Safari) and Android (Chrome).
✅ A clear error message is shown if the upload fails.

tasks.subject: Add “Own” and “All” options to Staff access (same as Calendar)
tasks.description:
In Edit Assistant → Staff access there are only Read and Write toggles. Calendar and Booking system already have Own / All options. Staff access should work the same way, so a limited user like Sonny can see and edit their own profile but not other people’s. Right now Sonny gets the “Åtkomst nekad” (Access denied) screen when he tries to open or save staff pages. “Own” lets a staff member see and edit only their own profile. “All” gives access to every staff profile in one click.

cceptance Criteria

✅ Staff access shows Own and All under both Read and Write, matching Calendar (same labels, tooltips and design).
✅ With Own, the user can open and edit only their own staff profile.
✅ With Own, other staff profiles are hidden or blocked.
✅ With All, the user can see and edit every staff profile.
✅ An admin can give full access in one click using the All option, without ticking each permission manually.
✅ A user with Own access never sees “Åtkomst nekad” on their own profile.
✅ A user without permission for another profile sees “Åtkomst nekad” with a working “Tillbaka till startsidan” button.
✅ Permissions are enforced in the backend (API), not only hidden in the UI.
✅ The selection is saved and persists after reload.
✅ Existing staff permissions are migrated so nobody gets more access than before.
✅ Tested with Sonny’s account.

tasks.subject: Add “Duplicate service” function
tasks.description:
Users need to be able to duplicate an existing service instead of creating a similar one from scratch. This saves time when creating services with similar settings.

Acceptance Criteria

✅ A “Duplicate” action is available on each service (list and/or service page).
✅ Clicking it creates a copy with all settings (price, duration, category, description, staff, etc.).
✅ The copy is named “\[Original name] (copy)” and can be renamed.
✅ The user is taken to the new service in edit mode.
✅ The original service stays unchanged.
✅ Works on desktop and mobile.

tasks.subject: Show phone number in booking” does not save (Staff)
tasks.description:
In the staff profile, ticking “Show phone number in booking” is not saved. After publishing and reopening, the checkbox is unchecked again.

Acceptance Criteria

✅ Ticking “Show phone number in booking” and publishing saves the setting.
✅ The checkbox keeps its state after reload.
✅ Unticking it and publishing also saves correctly.
✅ When enabled, the staff phone number is shown to customers in the booking flow.
✅ When disabled, the phone number is not shown in the booking flow.

tasks.subject: Frontend, Jev field/section spotlight and cursor targeting across edit surfaces
tasks.description:
When Jev guides a user, it should be able to highlight the exact field or section they need and point the cursor to it. This should work on all edit pages (staff, services, booking rules, settings, etc.), so users can see where to act instead of searching the page.

Acceptance Criteria

✅ Jev can spotlight a specific field or section on any edit page.
✅ The cursor/pointer moves to the targeted field and the page scrolls it into view.
✅ The spotlight works for fields inside collapsed sections by opening the section first.
✅ The spotlight is removed when the user clicks, types or dismisses it.
✅ If the target field does not exist or is hidden, Jev shows a fallback message and does not break the page.
✅ Works on desktop.

tasks.subject: Frontend, Jev deep-links and pick flows for dashboard modules across the sidebar
tasks.description:
Jev should be able to take users directly to any module in the dashboard sidebar (Calendar, Services, Staff, Customers, Deals, etc.). When the request is unclear, Jev should let the user pick from a short list of matching modules.

Acceptance Criteria

✅ Jev deep-links to every sidebar module (Calendar, Booking system, Service categories, Services, Staff, Customers, Discount, Journal, Deals, Loyalty card, etc.).
✅ When more than one module matches, Jev shows a pick list and opens the one the user selects.
✅ Deep-links respect user permissions, and users without access see the “Åtkomst nekad” message.
✅ The correct sidebar item is highlighted after navigation.
✅ Works in all supported languages (e.g. English and Swedish).
✅ Works on desktop and mobile.

tasks.subject: Frontend, Jev create-intent routing so create actions open the right Aspio flows
tasks.description:
When a user asks Jev to create something (e.g. “create a service”, “add a staff member”, “new discount”), Jev should open the correct creation flow in Aspio, not a settings page or a wrong module.

Acceptance Criteria

✅ “Create/add/new” requests open the correct creation flow for services, staff, customers, discounts, deals and other modules.
✅ The creation page opens ready to fill in, with no extra clicks.
✅ Create requests never land on a settings or list page by mistake.
✅ If the module is unclear, Jev asks the user to pick one before opening anything.
✅ Users without Write access are told they don’t have permission.
✅ Works on desktop and mobile.

tasks.subject: Backend, Jev catalog phrase expansions and entries for Aspio modules
tasks.description:
Jev’s catalog needs more phrases and entries so it understands how users actually describe Aspio modules. This includes synonyms, alternate wording and Swedish/English variants, so requests like “add a haircut” or “lägg till personal” map to the right module.

Acceptance Criteria

✅ Every Aspio module has a catalog entry with its name, route and create/edit actions.
✅ Each entry has a list of phrase variations, synonyms and common wording.
✅ Swedish and English phrases are both covered.
✅ New phrases are tested and return the correct module.
✅ No duplicate or conflicting phrases between modules.
✅ The catalog is easy to extend and is documented briefly.

tasks.subject: Backend, Jev catalog match guards so create/nav intents are not stolen by settings
tasks.description:
Right now, requests to create something or go to a module can be matched to a settings entry instead, because settings contain similar words. We need match guards so create and navigation intents always win over settings matches.

Acceptance Criteria

✅ Create and navigation intents have priority over settings matches.
✅ Settings entries are only matched when the user clearly asks for settings.
✅ Test cases cover phrases that used to be matched to settings by mistake (e.g. “create a service”, “go to staff”).
✅ Existing correct settings matches still work.
✅ Match results are logged so wrong matches can be debugged.
✅ Tests are added and pass.

tasks.subject: Backend, Jev action CTAs, ambiguous-field clarify paths, lint and build
tasks.description:
Jev’s answers should include clear action buttons (CTAs) such as “Open Services” or “Create staff”. When a field name is ambiguous (e.g. “price” exists in several places), Jev should ask a short clarifying question instead of guessing. The code must also pass lint and build.

Acceptance Criteria

✅ Jev responses include the correct action CTA (open, create, edit) when relevant.
✅ Each CTA opens the right page, flow or field.
✅ When a field name matches more than one field, Jev asks which one the user means and shows the options.
✅ After the user clarifies, Jev continues with the correct action.
✅ Lint passes with no errors or new warnings.
✅ Build passes in CI.
✅ Tests cover CTAs and clarify paths.

tasks.subject: Staff: give access when creating a staff member, without publishing first
tasks.description:
Today you must create and publish a staff member first, and only then can you give them access (“Personalåtkomst”). Access should be possible during creation, so that the staff member can be set up in one step.

✅ The create staff form has the access section (access on or off, page permissions, and the options for trash, restore and check-in/out for others)
✅ The access can be given while the staff member is still a draft, without publishing first
✅ The invitation is sent when the staff member is saved, or when the admin clicks “Send invitation”, and it needs a valid email address
✅ A clear message is shown if the email address is missing or already used
✅ The access settings are saved with the staff member and are the same when the member is opened later
✅ Publishing and access are separate, so a draft staff member with access can log in without being shown to customers
✅ The staff member can only log in with the permissions given, and nothing else
✅ The edit staff screen and the create staff screen show the same access section
✅ Checked in Swedish and English, on desktop and mobile

tasks.subject: Show each language name in its own language in the language selector
tasks.description:
In the language selector (bottom of the sidebar), the language names change depending on the selected language. For example, when Swedish is selected, the list shows “Somaliska”, “Turkiska”, “Arabiska”, “Spanska” and “Italienska”. Each language should always be shown by its own name (native name), no matter which language the app is currently using. This is the standard way language pickers work, and it lets users find their language even if the app is in a language they don’t understand.

Acceptance Criteria

✅ Each language is shown in its own language: English, Svenska, Soomaali, Türkçe, العربية, Español, हिन्दी, Italiano.
✅ The names stay the same when the user switches the app language.
✅ The currently selected language is shown in its own name in the selector button at the bottom of the sidebar.
✅ The selected language keeps its checkmark and highlight in the list.
✅ The flags and order of the languages stay the same.
✅ Arabic is displayed correctly (right-to-left text, correct font) and the list alignment is not broken.
✅ The heading (“Språk” / “Language”) can still be translated, only the language names are fixed.
✅ Works on desktop and mobile, and in both the business app and the portal if the selector exists there.
✅ Any new language added later follows the same rule (native name).

tasks.subject: Implement Fixed Price Discount Logic for Business Platform & Campaigns
tasks.description:
Implement fixed-amount discount logic across Campaign Creation and Automatic Discount rules on the Business management platform.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Extend Campaign Creation UI and backend logic to support Fixed Price/Amount discounts alongside percentage discounts.

✅ Update Automatic Discount engine to evaluate and apply fixed-amount price deductions during checkout.

✅ Validate fixed discount constraints (minimum order total, maximum discount cap, non-negative price bounds).

tasks.subject: Implement Fixed Price Discount Logic for Marketplace Checkout & Campaigns
tasks.description:
Update Marketplace pricing and checkout engines to recognize, display, and apply fixed-amount campaign and automatic discounts.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Update Marketplace checkout pipeline to accurately calculate fixed-amount campaign discounts.

✅ Display itemized fixed-amount discount callouts on service listings and order summary pages.

✅ Ensure cross-channel synchronization so active fixed-price campaigns remain consistent between Business and Marketplace.

tasks.subject: SRA: make it optional and stop check-in prompts when it is off
tasks.description:
SRA should be a feature a company can turn on or off. When it is off, staff should not be asked to check in.

✅ There is an on/off setting for SRA in Settings
✅ When SRA is off, staff are not asked to check in, and check-in and check-out buttons, reminders and pop-ups are hidden
✅ When SRA is off, the Attendance tab and attendance reports are hidden, or show a clear message that SRA is off
✅ When SRA is on, check-in works as before
✅ Turning SRA off does not delete existing check-in data, and turning it on again shows it
✅ The default for new companies, and what happens to existing companies, is decided and written in the task
✅ Only Owner/Admin can change the setting
✅ Checked in Swedish and English, on desktop and mobile

tasks.subject: Decouple SAR into an Independent Workspace Module (Separate from Staff)
tasks.description:
Decouple the SAR (Service & Activity Reporting) module from the Staff module, restructuring it as an independent top-level workspace module.

Acceptance Criteria:

✅ Extract SAR module routes, permissions, and navigation items out of the Staff submodule bundle into a dedicated module architecture.

✅ Ensure independent access control and role-based permissions for SAR separate from Staff administration.

✅ Maintain existing data relationships while rendering SAR as its own primary navigation domain.

tasks.subject: Staff revenue: show the correct date in Money and in Bookings
tasks.description:
The date shown for staff revenue is wrong in Money and in Bookings. Find the cause and fix it.

✅ The cause is found and written in the task (for example time zone or the wrong date field)
✅ A booking shows the same, correct date in Money and in Bookings
✅ Dates use the business’s local time zone, and bookings close to midnight are checked
✅ Staff revenue per day, week and month adds up to the same totals as the bookings
✅ Existing wrong records are fixed, or the task says why they are not
✅ The date format follows the selected language
✅ Checked with real booking examples, in Swedish and English

tasks.subject: Petty cash: move it to Settings with an on/off switch
tasks.description:
Petty cash should be a setting that a company can turn on or off.

✅ There is an on/off switch for petty cash in Settings
✅ When it is off, petty cash is hidden everywhere (menu, buttons, pages), and it cannot be opened by typing the link
✅ When it is on, petty cash works as before
✅ Turning it off does not delete existing petty cash data, and turning it on again shows it
✅ The default for new companies, and what happens to existing companies, is decided and written in the task
✅ Only Owner/Admin can change the setting
✅ Checked in Swedish and English

tasks.subject: Hide staff from online booking: hide only in the marketplace
tasks.description:
Hide staff from online booking” should only stop customers from booking the person in the Marketplace. In Business, the owner should still be able to book them.

✅ A hidden staff member does not show in the Marketplace, in search or in the booking steps
✅ A direct link to a hidden staff member in the Marketplace does not work (page not found, or the person is not shown)
✅ In Business, the hidden staff member still shows in the staff list and calendar
✅ In Business, a booking can be created for a hidden staff member
✅ Existing bookings with the hidden staff member still show
✅ A small label such as “Hidden online” shows in Business, so people know why customers cannot book the person
✅ Turning the setting off shows the person in the Marketplace again
✅ Checked in Swedish and English

tasks.subject: Jev Search (backend): multi-language phrases so Cmd+K matches edit and navigate in every supported language
tasks.description:
Cmd+K should understand edit and navigate phrases in every supported language, and not only in English.

✅ Edit and navigate phrases are added for every supported language
✅ The same request in different languages gives the same result (same intent and same deep link)
✅ Phrases with different word order, small spelling mistakes and common short forms are matched
✅ Live classify and mock classify both use the full phrase list
✅ A phrase that is not understood gives a clear fallback result and no wrong link
✅ Tests cover each language, for example “edit staff” and “go to settings”
✅ Search still returns only results from the user’s own company

tasks.subject: Jev Search (backend): Advanced Settings with all fields, aliases, hub routing and correct deep-link tabs
tasks.description:
Search should find every field in Advanced Settings and open the right tab.

✅ Every field in Advanced Settings can be found by search
✅ Aliases are added, so other names for a field find it too (in every supported language)
✅ Hub routing works, so a search for a group of settings opens the settings hub page
✅ Each result’s deep link opens the correct tab and field, not only the first tab
✅ A new setting that is added later must have an alias entry, or the test fails
✅ Settings the user may not open are not shown in the results
✅ Tests cover each tab with a field, an alias and a hub search

tasks.subject: Jev Search (backend): staff edit and staff settings detail open the right section and fields
tasks.description:
A search such as “edit Anna’s working hours” should open that staff member at the right section and field.

✅ Search finds the staff member and the section or field asked for (for example personal info, services, availability, access and booking settings)
✅ The deep link opens the staff edit page at the right section, and focuses the field when it is a single field
